scope: GoldenLocalVisualShellV1 is accepted only as a bounded integrated-test candidate for VALORIA GOLDEN LOOKDEV SLICE v1 after the proven surface-only geometry blocker. It is not a family promotion and not GOLDEN LOOKDEV PASS.

strengths: Cliff shells replace the dominant coarse planar/faceted screen read with substantially denser smooth terrain surfaces.
Rock contacts use rounded authored profiles rather than the previous sparse faceted clusters.
Three local vegetation replacements remove the most obvious cone/tree silhouettes in the bounded Golden crop.
Source is editable BLEND + GLB with authored UVs, normals and exported tangents; 8,496 triangles total is mobile-reasonable for this proof.
risks: Ground/road/shoulder pieces intentionally appear as isolated rectangles in source preview because they are overlap shells; any visible island or perimeter after integration is an automatic visual failure.

No scale-out or closed-family promotion is authorized from this source gate.
